# Set-ZbxModule

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a frontend module.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxModule [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixModule>[]> [-Status <ZabbixModuleStatus>] [-Configuration <JsonElement>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A frontend module adds widgets or pages to the Zabbix frontend; it is listed once its files are in the frontend's modules folder, and runs once enabled. The Set-ZbxModule cmdlet changes the frontend modules given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with module.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every frontend module the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed frontend modules back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a frontend module

```powershell
Get-ZbxModule | Where-Object ModuleIdentifier -EQ 'inventory-report' | Set-ZbxModule -Status Disabled
```

Disables the inventory-report module, so the frontend stops loading it.

### Example 2: Change a frontend module and write the result

```powershell
Get-ZbxModule | Where-Object ModuleIdentifier -EQ 'inventory-report' | Set-ZbxModule -Status Disabled -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the inventory-report module back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixModule>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixModuleStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The module status values: MODULE_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `JsonElement`: Bound to -Configuration (ByPropertyName).
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixModule`: The module read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
